prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1237; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. Presenting complaints included low back pain radiating into the left paraspinal region, with stiffness and reduced range of motion, particularly with forward flexion and rotation. Neurological examination was within normal limits, with no motor deficits, sensory changes, or reflex asymmetry noted. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings.

Over the course of eight visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, targeted soft tissue mobilization, graded therapeutic exercise for core stabilization, and a home exercise program. Pain was managed with short-term over-the-counter analgesics and ice application as needed. Symptoms improved steadily, with pain intensity decreasing and functional tolerance for sitting, lifting, and driving increasing across the treatment period.

At the most recent visit, the patient demonstrated near-full lumbar range of motion, minimal residual tenderness, and independent completion of the home program. Diagnosis remains lumbar strain, resolving. Prognosis is good. The patient has been advised to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
